g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (second city, 7 days), dismissing hides the card and leaves the app as before, and the 'if the ad fails' field covers both no-fill and unconfirmed play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is a temporary second weather city, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is a tap on the weather bar on the third day of the week, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The second city is a new addition, and the single-city bar that exists today stays unchanged, so nothing free is removed or capped.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in app chrome on s01, which is rated safe, and there is no chat screen or unsafe content nearby.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is a product_change. The second weather city is not a slice of anything the app charges for (piece_of_paid_benefit is none, and no paid plan was seen). It is also not used in an observed core flow, since the core flows are only reading a story (f01) and browsing a category (f02).

c2_evidence.reason: The proposal cites no evidence. It claims the weather bar 'shows one place' and 'uses data the app already fetches', but s01.e29 says only 'Tap here for weather', and no element or mechanic supports either claim.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward expires after 7 days, nothing paid is given away, and nothing is taken from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The offer is a card on the Home surface that the user can ignore or dismiss, and it does not interrupt a task in progress.

c6_fits_simula.reason: It is a play-to-earn unit. The city is added only after the play is confirmed, and the trigger is a detectable tap on the weather bar.

c7_specific.reason: It is tied to this app's Home weather bar (s01.e29) and its feed placement, so it would not read the same in any app.

other_concern: The 'third day in the same week' trigger needs the app to keep a per-week counter, which was not observed. The 'when the reward runs out' note is copy the proposal adds. The weather bar is not the ad slot, which is fine.
